_doc: Search space definition + accumulating list of masks the agent has proposed across iterations. Agent reads tried_masks to avoid re-proposing; appends new entries each iter via the loop driver.
mask_form_doc: Each mask MUST be one consecutive run of layer indices: [start, start+1, ..., start+k-1]. Multi-segment / gap masks are auto-rejected by driver validation. This matches the recovery adapter design (one boundary cut per mask).
start_constraint_doc: valid start ∈ [0, 32-k]. Agent should DISCOVER which start positions matter via SR feedback, not be told.
search_strategy_hint: Progressive: sweep small k (~8) starts first → identify best contiguous block → extend k upward into the successful direction. Agent decides progression speed.
constraint: Single physical mask, one contiguous block only; recovery via swappable modules.
